# Official Baselines

Model-specific integration is kept in `../comparison`.

| Baseline | Official Repository | Commit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Painter | <https://github.com/baaivision/Painter> | `cfec84587da2a2cc4e0b9acebe6fba1666e66477` |
| Prompt-Diffusion | <https://github.com/Zhendong-Wang/Prompt-Diffusion> | `8ecd2d126d9f9e17b80d9655bf8ed2df2e93f660` |
| InstructDiffusion | <https://github.com/cientgu/InstructDiffusion> | `435f0c3e4bd4dce4223df6ad4de1b511498a6138` |
| MAE-VQGAN | <https://github.com/amirbar/visual_prompting> | `6351e0d786c2d25bfdd5fe504153b1dfb345fa81` |
| VisualCloze | <https://github.com/lzyhha/VisualCloze> | `b3dda649cb197969fa2b23a5a6b28fc2b2566014` |
| PromptGIP | <https://github.com/lyh-18/PromptGIP> | `aa7e297aa6140a39b472fb22e099517c05a4a557` |

The competitor split contains 11 tasks and 100 distinct query pairs per task.
Same-task demonstrations never reuse the corresponding query pair.

Machine-readable provenance is in `SOURCES.json`.
